versions.subject: More suspicious flag fot bitsadmin execution
versions.detection:
selection1:
    Image|endswith:
        - '\bitsadmin.exe'
susp_flag_1:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' /transfer '
susp_flag_2:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' /create '
        - ' /addfile '
http_flag:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'http'
selection2:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'copy bitsadmin.exe'
condition: (selection1 and susp_flag_2 and http_flag) or (selection1 and susp_flag_1) or selection2
versions.spl: (Image="*\\bitsadmin.exe" CommandLine IN ("* /create *", "* /addfile *") CommandLine="*http*") OR (Image="*\\bitsadmin.exe" CommandLine="* /transfer *") OR CommandLine="*copy bitsadmin.exe*"
